verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud markets built-in AI capabilities, Grafana Assistant and Investigations, and natural-language understanding of production systems [grafana-docs-45, grafana-docs-8]. Its knowledge graph is described as generating insights about issues without complex queries [grafana-docs-44]. This covers the core of the story, but the evidence is short vendor marketing copy. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how Assistant and Investigations produce insights and suggestions, explicit evidence of actionable suggestions, availability beyond Grafana Cloud, independent or hands-on corroboration.
